protocol.purpose: historical reliability geometry diagnosis; not a new online method registration
protocol.feature_scale: fixed RMS deviation of base FSBO features on the complete 512 public historical coordinates
protocol.distance: mean squared feature difference divided by fixed feature scale squared
protocol.dynamic_rule: recompute locality from current target features; never recompute past prequery log likelihoods
protocol.source_conditioning: converged CPU float64; gradient at most 1e-10
protocol.target_adaptation: reuse original 129 CUDA states; no new training
protocol.raw_probability: unchanged cached physical component; this test isolates reliability geometry
protocol.teacher_scope: same existing teachers; own explicit source posterior excluded; not strict held-system validation
protocol.selection: leave one historical lineage out for bandwidth; NLL, Brier, larger bandwidth
protocol.screening: adapted feature NLL lower and Brier no higher than global and selected fixed feature and physical distances; positive NLL gain on at least two historical lineages in each scenario
